subject: Sumocho Cave secret room
text: The Sumocho Cave secret room is reached three steps up in the dark hallway before the boss, through the wall on the left.

evidence.quote: Three steps up in the dark hallway before the boss through the wall on the left.

subject: Sumocho Cave secret room
text: Before the boss, once the hallway goes dark, keep pushing to the left side of the screen to find the secret room.

evidence.quote: Before the boss when the hall way starts to get dark keep pushing to your left hand side of the screen and you will find it.

subject: Off With Their Heads

evidence.quote: Achievement will not pop until leaving the room, not after killing the boss.
